text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ufufufu~. A splendid success, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, we did it! And since we talked a 
big game, promising they could count on 
us... 
We've absolutely got to make this an event 
everyone can enjoy!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. We were able to unite our hearts 
with everyone in the Mejiro family. 
Now all that's left is to charge 
forward~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "! Um... Ramonu-san!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much for earlier! 
For giving us that push...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"—Don't mention it. 
You did invite me to a wonderful race, 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "! ...Ah... Thank goodness..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, do you have a little time after 
this? 
I was thinking of uploading the video of 
that race to social media."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, we should cut out the 
unnecessary parts. 
Shall we drop by an internet cafe or 
somewhere to work on it?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Bright was so dignified during the 
meeting. Dober was really proactive, too.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(...There it is again... That nagging 
feeling in my chest...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Why can't I just be happy from the 
bottom of my heart...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Ah! Um, what I just said was...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
That is simply the way of things. When 
fledglings leave the nest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"The eyes that once looked up so adorably 
at you, before you know it, are gazing at 
the sky, 
filled with the will to spread their 
wings."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(...Fledglings leaving the nest... Ah, I 
see...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(So that's why, even though I'm happy... I 
feel lonely... and end up feeling like 
this... 
If so, then what I should do... for the 
two of them is...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —What will you do, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I will... watch over their hard work and 
support them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Ta-daaa! 
The Santa and reindeer costumes for the 
riddle treasure hunt game have arrived~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Wah...! You both look so cute! The 
costume designs... 
You asked the designer for that 
doll—Maki-chan, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. There are outfits for everyone to 
wear for the final send-off as well~. 
Look forward to yours too, Dober~♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Hmmmm... Hey, about the prize gifts for 
the game. 
The commemorative booklet and 
limited-edition calendar are fine, but 
what should we do about the keepsake...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... The usual Mejiro original merch 
might not appeal much to new fans... 
Maybe something practical for everyday use 
would be better?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...In that case, how about black tea~? 
Like a set of the tea leaves we drink at 
our tea parties."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, then why don't we have McQueen and 
Ardan-san choose them? 
You know, since the two of them can't join 
the event on the day."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Right, they're attending another party on 
behalf of the Mejiro family. 
—Yeah, I think that's a great idea. Their 
fans will surely be thrilled too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Starting tomorrow, we've got a whirlwind 
photoshoot rush for the limited-edition 
calendar! 
We're gonna shoot in all kinds of places! 
Let's do this, get hyyyyyped~~?!"

text_block_list.name: Bright & Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Huuuuuuu~♪ 
Hu... Huuuh!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: First up is us♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Come on, Dober, smile, smile~! Relaaax!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome. 
—How was that? Did it set the mood?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeek, so gorgeous~~! 
Ardan-san, that's an OK!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Ramonu-san, are you really fine with 
wearing your racing outfit at the 
racetrack again this year...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. After all, it is where I shine the 
most brilliantly. 
—Now, let us begin."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Good work, everyone~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Man, getting everything ready is 
seriously tough work~~! 
But tomorrow is finally the big day! Let's 
give it our all!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Yes~. Um, would it be alright if we 
excused ourselves here? 
There is somewhere we would like to stop 
by~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha. See you at the venue tomorrow, 
then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, how about this one? 
A fluffy scarf. It's simple and cute."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"It is quite cute and lovely~. 
Ah, there are matching ear covers too~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"You're right. Let's make it a set! 
What color should we get? Gray or white, 
which do you think is better—"
